analysis.rationale: The candidate itself states it is an evidence-gap signal, not a world-process change. The core fact is that the 2026-08-09 web-search dossier contains no source-level facts, URLs, publishers, or publication dates — only a statement that strong signals are emerging. With zero trigger sources, zero corroborating sources, and no independently verifiable facts about any domain (AI, energy, semiconductors, geopolitics), no existing Global Process can be meaningfully matched or updated. The suggested match to 'process-geopolitical-technology-control' at confidence 11 is unsupported by any evidence and is properly rejected. This is a meta-signal about evidence collection quality, not a signal about the world.
